notes.title: Electron media loading
notes.content:
The black video player

Chromium refuses file:// subresources from an http:// document. The dev renderer is served over http://localhost, so attached videos rendered as a black player with dead controls.

Fix: a custom praxis-media:// scheme registered as standard, secure and stream, so range requests work for seeking.

notes.title: SQLite migration traps
notes.content:
Foreign keys during migrations

Drizzle rebuilds tables inside its own transaction. PRAGMA foreign_keys is a no-op inside a transaction, so the DROP step cascades and wipes child rows.

  • Toggle the pragma on the raw handle, outside any transaction

  • Restore it in a finally

  • SQLite cannot drop a NOT NULL constraint — rebuild the table

notes.title: Training block — next 6 weeks
notes.content:
Structure

Push/Pull/Legs, Monday–Wednesday–Friday. Progress reps first, then load.

  1. Weeks 1–2: rebuild volume, leave two reps in reserve

  2. Weeks 3–4: push to near failure on the last set

  3. Weeks 5–6: add load, drop the rep range

Deload the week after, regardless of how it feels.
